seed: The wide reference edit (100 tracks, 200 recordings, up to ten playing at once), at Next defaults: the timeline scrolled down and up through every track, zoomed and scrolled along, played end to end at 1x, every picture of its busiest stretch held against the export's, and a track added, a clip added, a move, a trim, a blade and an undo made while it plays. Run by Scripts/perf/speed-walk.sh --wide.
